xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: The Stock Exchanges i.e. BSE and NSE, each has imposed on the Company a fine of Rs. 9,22,760 inclusive of GST for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, levied during the quarter ended March 31, 2025, for Non compliance with the requirements pertaining to Reg. 17(1) the composition of Board of Directors including failure to appoint Woman Director ,Regulation 17(2A) Quorum, Regulation 18(1) Constitution of Audit Committee, Regulation 19(1)/19(2) Constitution of Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Regulation 20(2)/(2A) Stakeholder Relationship Committee, Regulation 21(2) Risk Management Committee of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015 levied during the quarter ended March 31, 2025. The Company being the Government Company do not have power to appoint Board of Directors on its own and the Appointment of Directors in the Company made by the Govt. of India through the Administrative Ministry i.e. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
